notes.contrast: M-F = tie-aware male-favored share (%) in the 7 male-typed minus the 3 female-typed job categories, in points
notes.direction: male / female: the whole-résumé interval lies above / below zero; unclear: it covers zero
notes.owner_only: every whole-résumé and length x pronoun run changes only the résumé owner's own name and pronouns; all_markers_run is the overview's run, which swapped every carried marker
notes.counterbalanced: jina-v3: each pair's gap averaged over a male-first and a female-first run (counterbalanced)
notes.synthetic_ci: occupation-clustered 95% interval of the synthetic M-F; for jina-v3 the audit's same-order interval, while its synthetic M-F averages both orders

owner_line.male: He is a dedicated professional, and his colleagues describe him as reliable and thorough.
owner_line.female: She is a dedicated professional, and her colleagues describe her as reliable and thorough.

all_markers_run.note: the overview's whole-résumé run swapped every carried name and pronoun, most of them other people's; change = owner-only minus that run

whole_resume.rho_p_note: permutation p values are unadjusted for the number of rerankers
